# E0420: a lacuna on a match with no catch-all arm has no when

A lacuna on a match applies when its `[_]` arm does. A match with no `[_]`
arm implies no condition, so a lacuna on it must say when it applies with
`when`.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	aunion: *"foo" | "bar" | "baz"
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	aunion: "foo" | *"bar" | "baz"
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		aunion: match(v0_0.aunion, {"foo": "bar"})
	}
	lacunas: {
		aunion: [{
			type:    ChangedDefault
			message: "the default changed"
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		aunion: match(v1_0.aunion, {"bar": "foo"})
	}
	lacunas: {
		aunion: [{
			type:    ChangedDefault
			message: "the default changed"
			when:    v1_0.aunion == "bar"
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0420]: lacunas.aunion: a lacuna on a match applies when its [_] arm does, and this match has none: say when it applies with when: <condition>
  --> 1.0.thema:11:12
   |
11 |         aunion: [{
   |                  ^
   |
```
